verdict.rationale: Git workflow is a fair question for a coding agent, but the evidence pack never documents the agent staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, or opening pull requests. Worktree sessions (isolated repo copies) and /fork (session branching) are adjacent features, not git commit or PR capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests
